Excellent grilled fish - must visit restaurant
Sep 2023 • Couples
What an excellent find. We read about this on the net, and it was a short walk from our hotel. There was a young waiter who spoke good English, and assisted us in demonstrating what to do with all the ingredients. 

Which is - heat the fish, add the greens, mix it up in the pan. Take some vermicelli, put the fish/greens on top, add some fried onions, mint, peanuts.. and what a perfect meal. 

Definitely worth a visit. Very economical, and excellent service; even thugh we don't speak Vietnamese.

Great restaurant serving authentic food
Oct 2018 • Family
My family visit this restaurant every week, since it is not always that you find such a good restaurant that serves cha ca. Despite the abundance of cha ca restaurants in Hanoi, this is probably the best place. The food is of great quality, the fish from the best sources (the unpolluted Da river), and served generously with herbs with a good price, while suitable for old age. The service is also quite good, with helpful waiters and waitresses responding to your requests as quick as possible, whether it is asking to relight the cooker, asking for more sauce, etc.

The restaurant is cozy, providing a good family experience. It is extremely pleasant to eat here in colder weather of autumn and winter. They also provide services to deliver your food home for parties and celebrations, so it is also a choice.
